title: Fixed canonical data for the direct-image internal-Hom comparison
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback $L_f=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image $R_f=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], derived internal Hom $\mathcal H_X=R\mathcal Hom_X$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Use the canonical pullback adjunction $a_f:L_f\dashv R_f$ of [def-sfb-canonical-scheme-derived-adjunction-composition], pinned to the simultaneous left-derived counit, the right-derived unit and the ordinary tensor-pullback adjunction. Let $t_f:L_f(A\otimes^L B)\xrightarrow{\sim}L_fA\otimes^L L_fB$ be the fixed natural tensorator whose forward components are the canonical shared-counit comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison], packaged as an isomorphism by [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso]. Let $b_X(A,E,N):\operatorname{Hom}(A,\mathcal H_X(E,N))\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A\otimes^L E,N)$ be the fixed uncurrying bijection [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection]. Define $c_f:R_f\mathcal H_X(-,-)\to\mathcal H_Y(R_f(-),R_f(-))$ to be the natural transformation specified by [lem-sc-mixed-hom-direct-image-comparison]: for all $E,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $A\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $\alpha:A\to R_f\mathcal H_X(E,N)$, $b_Y(\alpha;c_f(E,N))$ is the $a_f$-transpose of the composite $L_f(A\otimes^L R_fE)\xrightarrow{t_f}L_fA\otimes^L L_fR_fE\xrightarrow{1\otimes\epsilon_E}L_fA\otimes^L E\xrightarrow{b_X(a_f^{-1}(\alpha))}N$, where $\epsilon$ is the counit of $a_f$ and semicolon denotes composition in the displayed order. This equation determines the comparison uniquely; select the existing natural transformation with this specification. This is the evaluation-mate map of Tag 0B69, without quasi-coherence, boundedness, compactness or any adjunction having $R_f$ as left adjoint.
